rules.sentence: Results from a study reported a 45% incidence of PAVSD in children with DiGeorge syndrome (22q11 deletion); DiGeorge syndrome is associated with a lack of a thymus, which may be evidenced during surgical correction.[5][8]
Alagille syndrome associated with PAVSD carries a grave prognosis.[6]
Luckily, TOF overlaps significantly with PAVSD and may even be managed as such, decreasing ambiguity about the treatment.
